technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with momentum confirmation (AO cross-up, OBV rising) offset by overbought conditions and price below key moving averages, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: ADBE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 77 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with net 2 sales vs 1 purchase (small amounts, non-senior members); Fear index (40) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (411.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, imminent NFP event (1 day), and earnings binary 77 days out create hostile trading environment for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Momentum confirmation (AO cross-up, OBV rising, Supertrend bullish) with price near support (455.68) offers technical entry setup in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 411.2, flat yield curve, NFP in 1 day), overbought oscillators, price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, zero fundamental conviction, and high earnings risk 77 days out create hostile environment that overwhelms technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (AO cross-up, OBV rising, Supertrend bullish) offers moderate entry setup at support, but macro crisis environment and zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX in crisis territory (411.2), flat yield curve signaling recession, NFP event in 1 day, and earnings binary 77 days out create hostile macro backdrop that can trigger sharp reversals regardless of technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro override despite mixed technicals
